text:
maria: Quick heads-up — locking version flips in eu-central for a kernel patch tomorrow 09:00–10:00 UTC. Please do NOT change model->runtime mappings or release SDK bumps in that window.

deploy-bot: change-window scheduled by @maria — eu-central: 2026-04-14T09:00:00Z → 2026-04-14T10:00:00Z. Affected routes: /v1/complete, /v1/chat. Tags applied: compat-lock:20260414

jonathan: which model aliases are we freezing? any pinned tags?

maria: we'll attach label 'compat-lock:20260414' to aliases: redwood/gptx2q:stable and redwood/llama3q:prod. Runtime images will be held at image sha256:abc123... no tag rotations.

oliver: heads-up — SDK team has an urgent patch for sdk-js v1.3.5 that needs a runtime bump. Can we do emergency opt-in?

maria: emergency opt-ins allowed with two approvers: SRE + Product. Process: create a PR against infra/locks with label `emergency-unlock`, ping #eng-oncall, and include rollforward + rollback plan.

sre-oncall: ack. I'll be one approver. What's required for rollback plan?

jonathan: I'll prepare rollback script and smoke tests. Plan will include:
- steps to revert model alias
- container image rollback command
- smoke tests (replicate 5 requests across 3 regions)

jonathan: snippet I'll add to runbook:
```
infractl model alias set redwood/gptx2q:stable redwood/gptx2q:20260414-locked
infractl runtime image rollback --service inference-runtime --image-sha abc123
./smoke_tests/run --targets eu-central,us-west,ap-southeast
```

maria: link to PR template: https://git.redwood/infra/locks/pulls (please fill the 'risk' and 'test plan' sections). Also add release note that we briefly froze flips for eu-central and allowed opt-ins.

oliver: added PR #412, tagged @maria and @sre-oncall. Tests queued.

deploy-bot: PR #412 merged — emergency-unlock applied by jonathan. Lock override expires automatically at 2026-04-14T10:15:00Z unless extended.

maria: thanks — please post quick postmortem if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup: 

sre-oncall: will monitor logs and latency for next 2 hours. :eyes: 

oliver: smoke tests green. rolling patch now.

jonathan: rollback script pushed to infra/ops/scripts/rollback-1882501234.sh

maria: closing thread — update release notes and link to rollback script.

oliver: noted. :white_check_mark:
